analysis.d_full: THE TRACKER, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The ILR Labor Action Tracker is a joint research project by Cornell University's ILR School and the University of Illinois' LER School.' Database scope (against the BLS's 1,000-worker threshold); tools; recent trends. Five cards: the tracker, Cornell ILR (two), Facebook·The Daily Illini, BLS.
findings: THE SCOPE AGAINST THE STATE'S COUNT. 'Unlike official federal statistics—such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Work Stoppages Program, which only records large stoppages involving 1,000 or more workers'. The composition carries the tracker's reason to exist: the strikes the state's series does not count.
THE LINEAGE NOT CARRIED. 'We also thank the staff of the China Labour Bulletin for inspiring and encouraging us to develop this project.' (the tracker's About page; card 2's page repeats it).

THE SCOPE RAISED. 'captures work stoppages of all sizes (involving six or more workers)': 'six or more workers', 'filter by industry or state' and 'Labor Action Tracker Portal' are on no card or saved page, and the annual report's own limits on the count are not carried.

[QUERENT] Labor Action Tracker

[SYSTEM] The [ILR Labor Action Tracker](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVEH5RS0963ju37zGqQpYSCccVdoRykgLJcAr95H6hiYUzdDzQkBkvdCuo5nJoz4JDIix1UERZtKpp5vj4fsNEZJTL0Rzq9hvU_NBCj_sVkluaZvbEs-jwCHs) is a joint research project by Cornell University's ILR School and the University of Illinois' LER School. It provides a comprehensive database and interactive map tracking labor strikes, lockouts, and worker protest activity across the United States. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVQR9sTfuwS9D-QeVsN4BzBTWB2c581nhqe3kqFX6pqMzw2i_U1NYrE7roBBlUzlUv05_GMxBvoDmY2eqBRntLDF6M13pIuQnA81E28Yk1IVV2Nqdf00Xse_2ucbN5PQQtWzTKRc2UTC70q_Tte8m_K3694DejtuJv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESyQEB6zswFQlvkjLXiQ24lWFEcFOIVV0wtl5MunBYCP0vn_c1VK5O35lIgwn3e4MYkqyrEcvEAZASseFacEoD5cfndSWb9iNCAEoh6A6uwRMinu0gL-I5ArnVqkuh599nTl0m5W3hyxDo-lyO94WriFsrBkG_10ZR-LqBNYDJagUXNhxEviyJOqPHRlv9i5EK8P5lbmsvJe9mcdQ1xviwYD3rm1M7I-8Rwv_ug_qbMmGv7SVQinlUbz_KGqPM3VPhA8BOgX6R2ClgV5c)]
Key Features & Overview

* Database Scope: Unlike official federal statistics—such as the [U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Work Stoppages Program](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHrOzAVpb5oKnv_yyMruu6NnAXsucOunovn8N0yPmW7RoC5Gt-qVpyxG0J_XC1a5LbPc6EcIkXwhonEKXoGY1QBsapltscaRUts27CgZGVV), which only records large stoppages involving 1,000 or more workers—the Labor Action Tracker captures work stoppages of all sizes (involving six or more workers) as well as non-strike labor protests. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHrOzAVpb5oKnv_yyMruu6NnAXsucOunovn8N0yPmW7RoC5Gt-qVpyxG0J_XC1a5LbPc6EcIkXwhonEKXoGY1QBsapltscaRUts27CgZGVV), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESyQEB6zswFQlvkjLXiQ24lWFEcFOIVV0wtl5MunBYCP0vn_c1VK5O35lIgwn3e4MYkqyrEcvEAZASseFacEoD5cfndSWb9iNCAEoh6A6uwRMinu0gL-I5ArnVqkuh599nTl0m5W3hyxDo-lyO94WriFsrBkG_10ZR-LqBNYDJagUXNhxEviyJOqPHRlv9i5EK8P5lbmsvJe9mcdQ1xviwYD3rm1M7I-8Rwv_ug_qbMmGv7SVQinlUbz_KGqPM3VPhA8BOgX6R2ClgV5c)]
* Interactive Tools: Users can explore strike data, filter by industry or state, report a strike, and access annual summary reports via the Labor Action Tracker Portal. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVEH5RS0963ju37zGqQpYSCccVdoRykgLJcAr95H6hiYUzdDzQkBkvdCuo5nJoz4JDIix1UERZtKpp5vj4fsNEZJTL0Rzq9hvU_NBCj_sVkluaZvbEs-jwCHs), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVQR9sTfuwS9D-QeVsN4BzBTWB2c581nhqe3kqFX6pqMzw2i_U1NYrE7roBBlUzlUv05_GMxBvoDmY2eqBRntLDF6M13pIuQnA81E28Yk1IVV2Nqdf00Xse_2ucbN5PQQtWzTKRc2UTC70q_Tte8m_K3694DejtuJv)]
* Recent Trends: Recent annual reports highlight significant strike activity and shifting dynamics across the health care, social assistance, and food service sectors. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFV9oD1ymZ1t0hfjE3n1NMtL7jeILePQAlg9lSzGxDxqdDUHNsVepdtDdxUDIapZdqFf5d7ksp3gBptudhelpm1ygvro817HBB-xdh2Zw18OtsDugsOe1AKT_4X9ZZqAJZ7zslSdc5zJuYThkxo1mUd4ejR75zuMXjvvOXqCv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVEH5RS0963ju37zGqQpYSCccVdoRykgLJcAr95H6hiYUzdDzQkBkvdCuo5nJoz4JDIix1UERZtKpp5vj4fsNEZJTL0Rzq9hvU_NBCj_sVkluaZvbEs-jwCHs)]
